description:
JPMS modularized shade of org.mongodb:bson exposing the org.mongodb.bson module.

        Upstream ships only an Automatic-Module-Name, which jlink refuses:
        "automatic module cannot be used with jlink". The whole MongoDB driver chain
        (bson -> bson-record-codec -> mongodb-driver-core -> mongodb-driver-reactivestreams)
        arrives transitively through io.vertx:vertx-mongo-client, so each link needs a real
        module descriptor for a clean runtime image.
